rule: Every boundary audit fixture must replay before/after learning impact, rollback state, and blocked payment behavior before production recommendations change.
phase_one_guardrail: No rental payment, deposit, escrow, payout, booking commission, or payment-custody replay can apply shared learning.
replay_principles: Show the before recommendation state before applying any fixture delta.
Replay fixture impact as a simulation tied to a boundary audit event.
Show the after recommendation state only as a human-approved preview.
Keep rollback state visible before any production recommendation changes.
Keep blocked payment routes visible during replay.
Do not apply shared learning from replay until human approval and rollback visibility are present.
acceptance: Marketplace shows the Boundary Audit Replay Console strip after Boundary Audit Fixture Pack.
Buyer, supplier, and founder roles each show before state, replay delta, after state, rollback state, and blocked payment route.
Build Phase shows the v167 Boundary Audit Replay Console contract after the v166 Boundary Audit Fixture Pack contract.
Copy text exports fixture id, replay steps, approval promise, rollback promise, and blocked payment route.
Docs include replay routes, blocked replay routes, and required replay fields.
Static checks protect the v167 cache token, UI ids, app functions, CSS selectors, and JSON model.
